purpose: Exact Agent-State transition performed by the AGENT on a later direct HUMAN GO after a successful rc.6 reidentification bootstrap. Initialization itself remains read-only.
rules: This template is never written during initialization or reinitialization.
Use only on a later separate direct HUMAN GO after successful initialization evidence has been persisted by MASTER and pinned by the selected Job.
The AGENT owns the transition and MUST persist it by provider compare-and-swap at the exact prior Agent-State revision.
The prior runtimeStatus must be REIDENTIFICATION_REQUIRED.
Keep session and currentJob explicitly null.
Do not consume the current HUMAN GO during this rearm transition.
Validate the complete proposed state against targetSchemaRef before CAS and validate provider readback again afterwards.
After successful readback, continue the same direct HUMAN GO through normal job selection, GO-evidence persistence and atomic claim.
